overview.en: This small mochokid catfish is native to Lake Tanganyika, where it is endemic to the lake basin.
overview.fr: Ce petit poisson-chat mochokidé est originaire du lac Tanganyika, dont il est endémique.

identification.en: Its spotted pattern varies considerably, so spot size and spacing alone are not reliable identifiers.
identification.fr: Son motif de taches varie beaucoup : leur taille et leur espacement ne suffisent donc pas à l’identifier.

habitat.en: It is recorded from the rocky littoral of Lake Tanganyika.
habitat.fr: Il est signalé dans les zones rocheuses littorales du lac Tanganyika.

diet.en: Studies summarized in a taxonomic revision report algae and small invertebrates in adult diets; juveniles feed mainly on tiny invertebrates.
diet.fr: Une révision taxonomique rapporte que les adultes consomment des algues et de petits invertébrés, tandis que les jeunes mangent surtout de minuscules invertébrés.

behavior.en: The taxonomic revision summarizes feeding observations but provides little broader behavioral detail for this species.
behavior.fr: La révision taxonomique résume des observations alimentaires, mais donne peu de détails plus généraux sur le comportement de cette espèce.

reproduction.en: The 2006 taxonomic revision found no published account of this species’ spawning behavior.
reproduction.fr: La révision taxonomique de 2006 ne trouvait pas de description publiée du comportement de ponte de cette espèce.

ecology.en: The adjacent catalogue entry for Synodontis grandiops needs a taxonomic caveat: a 2024 revision treats that name as a junior synonym of S. multipunctatus, while retaining S. petricola as distinct.
ecology.fr: La fiche voisine de Synodontis grandiops demande une précision taxonomique : une révision de 2024 traite ce nom comme un synonyme plus récent de S. multipunctatus, tout en maintenant S. petricola comme espèce distincte.

conservation.en: FishBase reports a global IUCN category of Least Concern for this species.
conservation.fr: FishBase indique pour cette espèce le statut mondial UICN de préoccupation mineure.

title.en: Taxonomic revision of Lake Tanganyikan Synodontis — Florida Museum of Natural History
title.fr: Taxonomic revision of Lake Tanganyikan Synodontis — Florida Museum of Natural History

facts: The revision reports substantial variation in S. petricola spot size and spacing; it describes adult algae and small-invertebrate feeding and says spawning behavior was unknown.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

title.en: Revised taxonomy of Synodontis catfishes from the Lake Tanganyika basin — Zoological Journal of the Linnean Society
title.fr: Revised taxonomy of Synodontis catfishes from the Lake Tanganyika basin — Zoological Journal of the Linnean Society

facts: The 2024 revision recognizes S. petricola and places S. grandiops in synonymy with S. multipunctatus.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

facts: FishBase records the species from Lake Tanganyika and reports its global IUCN category as Least Concern.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

uncertainties: Species-specific behavioral and reproductive observations remain sparse in the sources consulted.
review_note: Draft only; the Synodontis grandiops comparison is a taxonomic clarification based on the 2024 revision, not a claim that the two names denote distinct current species.
